messages:
ana: heads-up — small but annoying parity bug between ruby-sdk and js-sdk streaming envelopes. sampleapp parser threw during the onboarding demo.

sam_k: oh no. what shape is ruby emitting now?

ana: after a refactor it started wrapping payloads in an outer `event` key. example:```
{"event": {"type":"delta","data":{"text":"hello"}}}
```
js/go currently emit:```
{"type":"delta","data":{"text":"hello"}}
```
sampleapp expects the latter, so it ignored the message stream intermittently.

louis: rough timeline? which PR introduced it?

ana: landed on main in #528 (stream marshaller tidy). I caught it when running the quickstart script for new users.

maya: was the envelope change intentional for metadata?

ana: yes, intent was to add trace/session metadata, but we missed signaling compatibility.

sam_k: shortest path: make sampleapp parsing resilient, add a tiny ruby-sdk unit test for parity with the js mock, and add an opt-in client flag for the new envelope. keep default backward-compatible for one release.

louis: agree. do a minimal fix — avoid broad revert. add CHANGELOG note and deprecation plan so downstreams know.

ana: plan implemented: `parse_stream_event(payload)` does `payload = payload['event'] if payload.key?('event')` then proceed. added tests for both shapes and a short README note in sampleapp.

ci-bot: build started for branch `ana/stream-envelope-compat` (job #4823).

ana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/541 — 3 files changed (parser tweak, tests, CHANGELOG). left TODO to expose `stream_envelope: :legacy|:new` in next minor.

sam_k: nice. keep PR tiny so we can backport to 0.8.x quickly if needed.

louis: reviewing. if CI green and tests cover both envelopes, we can merge and backport a patch.

maya: also add a one-liner in sampleapp README showing the tolerant parser. people copy that code a lot.

ana: will add README blurb and open backport after merge. thanks :bow:
